## PR 438

**Studio core — brand asset library, templates, rules (part 2) (V1 C5.5)**

**বাংলায়:** স্টুডিওর প্রথম অ্যাডমিন পেজ: অ্যাকাউন্ট, ব্র্যান্ড অ্যাসেট লাইব্রেরি (লোগো-ওভারলে-গান, প্রোডাক্টের ছবি থেকে আলাদা) আর টেমপ্লেট; কিছু মোছা হয় না

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: studio core part 2 (Blueprint C5.2, C5.4): templates (`@extas/studio/templates.ts`, the `StudioTemplate` table S00's skeleton already carries) — kind (image post, story, reel, short), name, a spec (aspect ratio, a reel/short's length, up to 10 brand-asset ids each checked against the library), versioned (bumped on every change), archive/restore, never deleted; the brand asset library (`assets.ts`) reusing the shared Media library's own `MediaAsset` rows filed under a new private folder `studio` (added to `@extas/media`'s `PRIVATE_MEDIA_FOLDERS`, so a brand asset never shows as a product photo and a product photo never shows here) — naming a file's kind (logo, overlay, brand frame, intro, outro, royalty-free track) on `studio.write`, archiving/restoring it through the Media library's own `archiveMedia`/`restoreMedia` (so also needs `media.manage`); the first admin page, `/admin/marketing/studio` (`marketing.studio` tab, hidden by `stages.closedShown.S23` until the stage finishes), listing PR 437's accounts alongside the new templates and brand assets — uploading a brand asset reuses `/api/admin/media` (needs `media.upload` too, same as every other admin picture picker); 15 new package tests (2 real-PostgreSQL files)
  - GitHub pull request #108, 11 Nov
- **What it does:** Studio core — brand asset library, templates, rules (part 2) (V1 C5.5) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `@extas/studio/templates.ts`, `assets.ts`, `@extas/media`
  - Routes: `/admin/marketing/studio`, `/api/admin/media`
  - Settings and named keys: `studio.write`, `media.manage`, `marketing.studio`, `stages.closedShown.S23`, `media.upload`
  - Names in the code: `StudioTemplate`, `MediaAsset`, `studio`, `PRIVATE_MEDIA_FOLDERS`, `archiveMedia`, `restoreMedia`
  - Tests: 15 new package tests (2 real-PostgreSQL files)
- **Owning agent:** Doot

## PR 439

**Video assembly engine — reels, shorts, image posts (V1 C5.5)**

**বাংলায়:** টেমপ্লেট আর প্রোডাক্ট দিয়ে তৈরির কাজ জমা আর চালানো; আজকের ফল শুধু প্রিভিউ (প্রোডাক্টের আগের ছবি), আসল ভিডিও/ছবি বানানো পরে আসবে

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: video assembly engine (Blueprint C5.2, C5.5 point 2; `@extas/studio/render.ts`, the `SocialRenderJob` table S00's skeleton already carries, `BackgroundStatus`): `queueSocialRender` (`studio.generate`) turns a template + a chosen list of products into a pure `RenderPlan` (scene order, the template's own brand assets grouped by kind, an owner-written caption) and queues a job; `NO_PRODUCTS`/`TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED`/`NOT_FOUND` refuse a bad job up front. `runSocialRenderJob` runs a queued job once (`WRONG_STATE` on a second run) — today's honest scope (Blueprint C5.2: no AI video model here) is a **preview only**: the output is the first featured product's own live lead photo (`ProductMedia.isPrimary`), never a fabricated file; the real compositor (overlay/caption baked into pixels, real video encoding) is a later PR once the server has an encoder, swapped in without touching the plan or the queue. Admin page gains a fourth section, "তৈরি হওয়া কনটেন্ট" (`StudioRenderForm`, template + comma-separated product ids + optional caption, a "তৈরি করুন" button per queued job, thumbnail once SUCCEEDED); `studioHandler`'s POST now picks `studio.write` or `studio.generate` by the action's own prefix. 10 new package tests (5 pure plan-builder, 5 real-PostgreSQL job lifecycle) + 1 new web `.db.test.ts` case (queue → run → reader-denied, through the page's own API)
  - GitHub pull request #115, 11 Nov
- **What it does:** Video assembly engine — reels, shorts, image posts (V1 C5.5) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `@extas/studio/render.ts`, `.db.test.ts`
  - Settings and named keys: `studio.generate`, `studio.write`
  - Names in the code: `SocialRenderJob`, `BackgroundStatus`, `queueSocialRender`, `RenderPlan`, `NO_PRODUCTS`, `TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `runSocialRenderJob`, `WRONG_STATE`, `ProductMedia.isPrimary`, `StudioRenderForm`, `studioHandler`
  - Tests: 10 new package tests (5 pure plan-builder, 5 real-PostgreSQL job lifecycle) + 1 new web `.db.test.ts` case (queue → run → reader-denied, through the page's own API)
- **Owning agent:** Doot
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#the-stage-table) · [Blueprint: C5.5 What gets built (+7 PRs, S23)](../BLUEPRINT.md#c55-what-gets-built-7-prs-s23) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s23--social--content-studio--in-progress-37-reopened-cn-039) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)
